# EnterpriseGlue v0.32.1 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.32.0`.

## Highlights

- **runtime-security:** Patches the plugin verification tools and runtime certificate and curl security floors.

## User and administrator impact

- Plugin acquisition and signature verification retain their existing interfaces.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Use the new signed application, bootstrap and plugin-toolchain image composition after qualification; existing published image digests remain unchanged.

## Database migrations

- No database or migration changes.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Pins github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.18.7 in both Cosign builds to address CVE-2026-63209 (GHSA-259r-337f-4rfw).
- Build-time binary inspection requires the patched module version. Vulnerability severity and ignore policies remain unchanged.
- Requires Go 1.26.10 for both ORAS and Cosign to address CVE-2026-111943, with build-time inspection of both emitted binaries.
- Requires ca-certificates-bundle 20260909-r3 and libcurl-openssl4 8.23.0-r0 in the application and bootstrap runtimes, addressing CVE-2026-111943 and CVE-2026-92392. Explicit floors override vulnerable package pins inherited from the base images.

## Documentation

- Both plugin container third-party notices identify the patched Cosign dependency.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-installer` | `0.2.11` | `0.2.12` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-manager` | `0.1.11` | `0.1.12` | patch |

## Known limitations

- An existing signed distribution lock cannot be silently retargeted to rebuilt toolchain images; a new signed release composition is required.

## Rollback

- Restoring earlier runtime or toolchain images reintroduces the vulnerable dependencies; prefer a forward fix.

## Validation evidence

- Installer and manager suites: 88 tests passed. The 13 dependency-security contracts, package/chart version discipline, release metadata and documentation boundary checks passed.
- Both patched backend runtime-base platforms passed the unchanged all-severity application Trivy policy using the pinned scanner and vulnerability database updated 2026-10-21T07:13:45Z. These runtime-base checks are separate from complete candidate image qualification.
- Both acquisition binaries report Go 1.26.10; Cosign retains the patched compression module and verifies the existing signed release candidate from a non-root read-only container.
- Publication requires protected CI and an exact-source signed candidate with current security acceptance for every runtime image on both supported architectures.

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `plugin-cosign-compression-security`
- Audiences: operators, developers, security
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
